title: Brain shown to secrete DMT endogenously, Michigan research

tellings.quote: for example well we now know the brain we thought that the brain couldn't produce it it was produced in the lungs now we know that the brain can endogen endogenously secrete the Mt and DMT receptors are all over the brain chemo Mortgage in at Michigan

plain: The brain can make DMT, a powerful psychedelic compound, on its own, and the brain is full of receptors for it, when scientists used to think it was only made in the lungs. The writer Graham Hancock says this on the show, citing work by a researcher at the University of Michigan named Jimo Borjigin. If true, visionary experiences might have a chemical root in the brain itself.
